_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for report figures that are NOT yet sourced from the database — hand-transcribed values and stopgaps pending a real extractor or data-entry wiring. Edit this file to update those numbers; changes apply on the next PDF/preview generation, no restart needed. Do NOT re-scatter these back into the page_*.py generators. Each top-level section names the page generator that consumes it. '_doc' keys (at any level) are ignored by the loader.

sail_mines._doc: page_sail_mines.py — 'SAIL Mines Production & Despatch Performance'. Charts are in million tonnes; the iron-ore group table is in '000 T. Stopgap per direct instruction 2026-08-27, a placeholder until real series / mine-level actuals exist. Chart colours stay in the page module (presentation, not data).

despatch_mix._doc: Iron-ore despatch mix by end-use, million tonnes, in despatch_mix_cats order. One entry per donut.

iron_ore_group_kt._doc: Iron Ore Production / Despatch and Sales of Iron Ore (Booked Qty / Despatch), delinked from the mine-level rollups per direct instruction 2026-08-27 (mine-level despatch/sales actuals were never entered). Each item -> [APP, YTD Actual Apr-Jul'26, YTD CPLY] in '000 T. The 'SAIL' rows stay derived (CGoM + OGoM + JGoM) and are NOT listed here. Restore the rollup calls in generate_sail_mines() once real figures land.

special_steel_physical._doc: page_special_steel_physical.py — 'Special Steel Plants Physical Performance'. cur-FY YTD Actual overrides in Tonnes, plant -> series -> value. Wins over the derived / production_table figure; %FF stays blank (no APP), %Growth is recomputed against CPLY. Stopgap per direct instruction 2026-08-27 ('will map later'). Remove an entry once a real source is wired for it.

key_parameters._doc: page_key_parameters.py — 'Inter Plant Performance Comparison' page. Values with no DB source yet, transcribed from Report_format/Plant wise Comparative for Apr-Jul'26.pdf. spec -> plant -> value. Cost of Production (HM/CS/SS and, since 2026-08-28, BF Coke + Sinter) comes from cost_trend_monthly (the DB), NOT here. RLTIFR moved to techno_data 'General' unit (key 'rltifr') on 2026-08-28. Only 'ss_in_finished' remains. Refresh when a real extractor lands or a newer comparative sheet supersedes this one.
